PostgreSQL_0:
SELECT account_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        MAX(amount) - MIN(amount) AS amount_difference,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) AS subquery
WHERE amount_difference > 12000;
PostgreSQL_1:
SELECT to_char(creationdate, 'H:MI:SS') AS formatted_time
FROM posts
WHERE creationdate IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10;
